name: Nomadix
verdict: A private US accessories brand launched by its three co-founders. Nothing found.
note: Official supplier of the U.S. SailGP Team for 2026 (ussailgpteam.com, 21 May 2026). Rating note (2026-09-30): co-founders Zack Helminiak, Chace Petersen and Hunter Robinson launched Nomadix in 2015 (nomadix.co blog, 4 Feb 2021), a US social purpose corporation. Its share register isn't public; no source names a state or state-fund shareholder, and no human-rights finding against the company was found.
